<robot name="chest_with_lid">
  <!-- Units: metres, kg -->

  <!-- Base pose: origin on floor under middle of object.
       X across width, Y toward back (front faces -Y), Z up. -->

  <!-- Dimensions -->
  <!-- Width (X): 1.01 m -->
  <!-- Height to top of closed lid (Z): 0.37 m (lid/toplevel height) -->
  <!-- Depth (Y): 0.51 m -->

  <!-- Assumptions for internal mass distribution (can be adjusted):
       - Chest/body: 0.20 m tall; lid: 0.17 m tall; total 0.37 m.
       - Lid rotates about the back top edge (hinge axis along X).
       - Lid opens by rotating about +X axis at hinge in +Y/back direction. -->

  <material name="wood">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.40 0.30 1"/>
  </material>

  <material name="wood_dark">
    <color rgba="0.45 0.32 0.24 1"/>
  </material>

  <!-- World link (static) -->
  <link name="world"/>

  <!-- Chest/body link -->
  <link name="chest_body">
    <inertial>
      <!-- Box approx: width 1.01, depth 0.51, height 0.20 -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.10" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <!-- inertia for solid box: Ixx = 1/12 m (y^2+z^2), Iyy = 1/12 m (x^2+z^2), Izz = 1/12 m (x^2+y^2) -->
      <!-- x=1.01, y=0.51, z=0.20 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.2246" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.3318" iyz="0" izz="0.5200"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.10" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.51 0.20"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.10" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.51 0.20"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Lid link -->
  <link name="chest_lid">
    <inertial>
      <!-- Lid box approx: width 1.01, depth 0.51, thickness 0.017? but need height 0.17 per assumption.
           Use a box of size 1.01 x 0.51 x 0.17 placed at its center.
           With hinge at back top edge: at closed state lid is horizontal at Z=0.20..0.37.
           Its center at Z = 0.20 + 0.17/2 = 0.285. In Y at 0 (mid-depth). -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="6.5"/>
      <!-- x=1.01, y=0.51, z=0.17 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.1351" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.2847" iyz="0" izz="0.4465"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Visual and collision for lid in its link frame at zero rotation (closed).
         Link frame chosen so that when joint angle=0, the lid is horizontal.
         For joint origin at hinge axis, this link's geometry is positioned at Z=0.285. -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.51 0.17"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.51 0.17"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Fixed base attachment -->
  <joint name="chest_body_to_world" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="chest_body"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Hinge joint for lid: rotates about X axis along back edge -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <parent link="chest_body"/>
    <child link="chest_lid"/>
    <!-- Hinge axis at back top edge of body.
         Back edge at Y = +0.51/2 = +0.255
         Top of body at Z = 0.20
         X centered at 0 -->
    <origin xyz="0 0.255 0.20" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <!-- Revolute axis along +X -->
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="1.57079632679" effort="50" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.2" friction="0.02"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
